title: Falling film boiling and pool boiling on plain circular tubes: Influence of surface roughness, surface material and saturation temperature on heat transfer and dryout
reason: The authors report their own measured heat transfer coefficients, enhancement factors and dryout thresholds for falling film boiling (with pool boiling baselines) of R-134a on horizontal plain tubes, stating "The study was conducted on an experimental set-up at saturation temperatures of 5 °C and 25 °C using refrigerant R-134a at heat fluxes from 20 to 90 kW/m2".
